decision.rationale: I recommend a provisional credit of 373.12 EUR for one of the two postings. Time limit: TXN-008098 posted on 2026-08-03 and the dispute was opened on 2026-10-24. That is 82 days, inside the 120-day limit. The ledger shows two purchases at HARBOUR GADGETS (MER-000023) on card CRD-000116, both for 373.12 EUR (37312 minor units) and both posted on 2026-08-03. They are TXN-008097, made at 2026-08-02T08:30:28Z, and TXN-008098, made at 2026-08-02T08:31:28Z. Both carry the same authorisation, AUTH-008288. That authorisation was approved once for 37312, as an online payment with 3-D Secure authenticated and the CVV matching. So one authorisation was posted twice. The card has no refunds at all. Under duplicate-same-authorisation the extra posting is credited. TXN-008098 is that extra posting, and 373.12 EUR is below the 3,000.00 EUR provisional credit limit. The credit equals the amount the cardholder claims and covers only one posting.
